description: This file contains various validation functions used for validating length, email addresses, IP addresses, filenames, URLs, and SEO URLs within the OpenCart project.

methods.name: oc_validate_length
methods.description: Validates if a string's trimmed length falls within the specified minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: oc_validate_email
methods.description: Validates whether an email address is syntactically correct, including IDN normalization.

methods.name: oc_validate_ip
methods.description: Validates whether an IP address is valid.

methods.name: oc_validate_filename
methods.description: Validates filename against allowed characters (Latin, Cyrillic, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore).

methods.name: oc_validate_url
methods.description: Validates whether a URL is properly formed.

methods.name: oc_validate_seo_url
methods.description: Validates whether a SEO keyword URL contains only allowed characters (Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, digits, slash, dot, hyphen, underscore).
